endorsements.name: Satoki Tsuji
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-5690
endorsements.description: By monitoring the time certain operations take, an attacker could have guessed which external protocol handlers were functional on a user's system. This vulnerability affects Firefox < 127, Firefox ESR < 115.12, and Thunderbird < 115.12.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

endorsements.name: Satoki Tsuji
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-9398
endorsements.description: By checking the result of calls to `window.open` with specifically set protocol handlers, an attacker could determine if the application which implements that protocol handler is installed. This vulnerability affects Firefox < 131, Firefox ESR < 128.3, Thunderbird < 128.3, and Thunderbird < 131.
